messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding playbook firing a bunch of enrichment webhooks for accounts with sparse metadata, causing webhook queue backpressure in integrations. Noticed ~120 spikes in the last 2 hours. Can CSOPS throttle or debounce these?
playbook-bot: alert: playbook 'onboard-enrich' triggered 118 times in 2h.
ajay: ugh saw the spike, thanks for flagging. what's generating the duplicates?
leo: probably the contact dedupe job + missing external id causing re-enrich on every touch.
sophie: proposal: add a 5m per-account debounce window in playbook runner + add 'max_attempts' label to enrichment hooks so downstream adapters can ignore repeats.
ajay: yeah + fallback to cached enrichment if available (age < 24h).
maria: can we do a quick test? if someone can flip the flag on staging to enable debounce for a subset of tenants.
leo: i'll patch the runner config and open a dry-run feature flag: /flags set playbook.debounce.onboard_enrich=staging:subset. will include the config diff in the PR.
sophie: also adding a small metric: enrich.debounce_hits count to metrics so we can see effect, and enrich.webhook_retries for visibility.
ajay: pinging infra to monitor queue length and webhook delivery latency during the test.
infra-bot: deploy queued: playbook-runner v1.14.2 -> staging (canary=2%). ETA ~6m.
maria: thanks all — i'll monitor Sentry logs and integrations dashboard. if debounce cuts the spikes we can roll to more tenants tomorrow. scheduling a 30m retro tomorrow 10:30 to review results and SLA implications.
ajay: quick note — if debounce reduces throughput we may need to adjust onboarding SLA thresholds and notify success managers.
sophie: noted, will add to the retro agenda and draft the rollout playbook to include a rollback plan. :thumbsup:
